comment: Variation of conduct-window-reaches-status: a debug-mode Monk raised only to experience level 26 attains one rank fewer, so the final conduct window's --More-- row ends on the last map row. docorner()'s half-open clear range then stops at WIN_STATUS->offy and clears no status cells, but ymax still reaches that row, so docorner() still sets disp.botlx and calls bot().
